description: Use when the request mentions Agent Skills, `SKILL.md`, a skill folder, a skill release review/readiness verdict, or turning a workflow into a reusable skill, and asks to create, revise, refactor, organize resources for, evaluate, benchmark, validate, package, release-check, or fix activation for that skill. Do not use for ordinary code, document editing, generic packaging, or generic A/B testing unrelated to Agent Skills.
